title: Grid Sperner and the knot sphere need exponential resolution size, with every lemma proved
subject: Whether the resolution bounds for the knot's octahedral sphere hold without sketched steps, and whether grid Sperner with a fixed boundary needs exponential size in general resolution
conclusion: Every resolution refutation of the knot sphere needs width Theta(sqrt n) and size 2^Theta(sqrt n), now with every lemma proved through single-step vortex moves, straight cuts giving d >= (dist - 19)/2, and a row count. Grid Sperner with its fixed boundary, and the Itsykson-Malova-Oparin-Sokolov Sperner CSP, need width Omega(m) and size 2^Omega(m), because with three straight cuts the fixed boundary is a flat state.
